name: Matooke
imageAlt: Cooked yellow-green bananas served with pieces of meat in sauce; the image includes a Mom’s Village Kitchen watermark.
description: Green bananas are gently steamed until tender, then served as a soft, satisfying centerpiece.
madeWith: Green cooking bananas, often steamed in banana leaves.
enjoyedWith: Groundnut sauce, beans, or a savory stew.
moment: A familiar choice for a shared lunch or supper.
character: Mild, tender, and wonderfully good at carrying sauce.

name: Luwombo
imageAlt: A luwombo meal wrapped and cooked in banana leaves.
description: A richly flavored stew cooked in a parcel of banana leaves, which helps hold in its aroma.
madeWith: A base such as chicken, beef, or groundnuts, with aromatics and sauce.
enjoyedWith: Matooke, rice, or another staple for soaking up the sauce.
moment: A special meal that rewards a little time at the table.

name: Rolex
imageAlt: A sliced Ugandan Rolex wrap showing egg and flatbread layers.
description: A warm chapati wrapped around an omelette, often with vegetables folded into the egg.
madeWith: Chapati, eggs, and commonly onion, tomato, or greens.
enjoyedWith: On its own as a hand-held snack or quick meal.
moment: An easy pick when you want something filling on the go.
character: Soft, savory, and easy to make your own.

name: Posho
imageAlt: Posho served with beans and leafy greens.
description: A firm maize-flour staple that brings a comforting, neutral base to a plate.
madeWith: Maize flour stirred into hot water until smooth and firm.
enjoyedWith: Beans, greens, or a sauce-rich stew.
moment: A hearty accompaniment for a meal built around stewed vegetables or beans.
character: Subtle, filling, and made to be paired.

name: Groundnut sauce
imageAlt: A bowl of orange-brown groundnut soup with peanuts and herbs; the image includes the baked-in headline “How To Make Groundnut Soup.”
description: A savory, peanut-based sauce with a deep, rounded flavor and a velvety feel.
madeWith: Ground peanuts, water, and seasonings; recipes vary from kitchen to kitchen.
enjoyedWith: Matooke, sweet potato, cassava, or greens.
moment: A generous spoonful can bring several parts of a meal together.

name: Malewa
imageAlt: Smoked bamboo shoots, the traditional Ugandan dish known as malewa.
description: Smoked bamboo shoots, enjoyed on their own or simmered into a richly flavored dish.
madeWith: Bamboo shoots that are smoked and softened during preparation.
enjoyedWith: Often paired with a staple such as matooke or millet bread.
moment: A distinctive taste to seek out when exploring regional food traditions.
character: Smoky, tender, and full of character.

name: Kikomando
imageAlt: A serving of Kikomando; the source image includes the words “Ugandan Kikomando.”
description: Sliced chapati served with beans: a simple, filling pairing that makes a little go a long way.
madeWith: Chapati and cooked beans, with optional additions depending on the cook.
enjoyedWith: As a satisfying meal on its own.
moment: A handy, budget-minded lunch or casual bite.

name: Katogo
imageAlt: A bowl of chunky, sauce-rich katogo.
description: A one-pot meal that brings a starchy base and a savory sauce together as they cook.
madeWith: Common bases include matooke or cassava, cooked with beans, offal, or another sauce.
enjoyedWith: Often served as a complete, warming meal.
moment: A comforting start to the day or a substantial meal any time.
character: Soft, savory, and satisfying from the first spoonful.

name: Muchomo
imageAlt: Beef roasting over a fire in Uganda.
description: Pieces of meat roasted over a grill and served simply, letting the smoky char do the talking.
madeWith: Grilled meat, with seasoning and cuts varying by vendor.
enjoyedWith: A fresh salad, roasted plantain, or another side.
moment: A sociable snack to share while it is hot from the grill.
character: Smoky, savory, and best enjoyed fresh.

name: Chapati
imageAlt: A stack of golden, lightly browned Ugandan chapati flatbreads.
description: A soft, pan-cooked flatbread with a lightly browned surface and tender middle.
madeWith: A simple dough of flour, water, and a little fat.
enjoyedWith: Beans, stews, eggs, or rolled around a filling.
moment: A versatile side, snack, or foundation for a quick meal.
character: Warm, gently layered, and ready for anything.

name: Gonja
imageAlt: Golden plantain pieces cooked until soft.
description: Ripe plantain cooked until soft and sweet, often roasted or pan-fried.
madeWith: Ripe plantain, cooked simply over heat.
enjoyedWith: As a snack or alongside a savory meal.
moment: A lovely sweet-savory side when you want something warm.

name: Kalo
imageAlt: A firm, dark millet bread served in a woven basket.
description: A firm millet-based bread shaped into a dense, satisfying staple.
madeWith: Millet flour combined with hot water and worked to a firm consistency.
enjoyedWith: A sauce or stew, sometimes including groundnuts.
moment: A grounding accompaniment for a slower, shared meal.

name: Eshabwe
imageAlt: Creamy eshabwe served beside millet bread.
description: A traditional, creamy ghee-based sauce associated with Ankole food traditions.
madeWith: Ghee and water worked together, with seasoning; preparations differ.
enjoyedWith: Often served alongside millet bread or another staple.
moment: A distinctively rich accompaniment for a traditional meal.
character: Creamy, savory, and made for small portions.

name: Fish stew
imageAlt: Ugandan fish stew served with matooke, pumpkin, sweet potatoes, and French beans.
description: Fish gently cooked in a tomato-and-onion sauce until the flavors come together.
madeWith: Fish, tomato, onion, and seasonings; ingredients vary by cook.
moment: A comforting main dish for a meal shared around the table.

name: Mandazi
imageAlt: Golden fried mandazi pieces on a plate.
description: A lightly sweet, fried dough snack, often shaped into soft triangles or rounds.
madeWith: Flour, liquid, and a little sugar; recipes may include coconut or spice.
enjoyedWith: Tea or coffee, or simply eaten warm as a snack.
moment: A welcome treat at breakfast or tea time.
character: Pillowy, gently sweet, and best fresh.

name: Nsenene
imageAlt: A close-up of cooked grasshoppers prepared as nsenene.
description: Edible grasshoppers, typically prepared by frying until crisp and well seasoned.
madeWith: Grasshoppers cooked with salt and seasoning.
enjoyedWith: As a crunchy snack on its own.
moment: A memorable local specialty for adventurous eaters.

name: Sweet potato
imageAlt: Cooked sweet potatoes displayed together at a market.
description: A naturally sweet root vegetable that can be boiled, steamed, or roasted until tender.
moment: A comforting breakfast or an easy side dish.
